name: Honda CT90 Trail 90
engine: 89 cc air-cooled OHC single, one carb, dual-range gearbox (most)
intro: Honda's step-through trail bike. Simple to bring back. Mind the cam timing on reassembly.

add.title: Check cam timing marks on reassembly
add.instructions: The cam can go in two ways. Line up the marks on the cam and sprocket before you button it up.
add.reason: A cam fitted 180 degrees out is a common reason a rebuilt CT90 won't start.

G: The pilot jet has a tiny hole that clogs with varnish. Make sure you can see light through it.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Won't start after rebuild
known.what: Installing the cam 180 degrees out is a common mistake.
